reason: Both open with the same stop-using warning, tell the user to unplug and stop resetting, and say not to open the casing. Neither asks the key follow-up about whether the RCD stays set with the microwave unplugged. Conversation 1 names the lethal-capacitor risk clearly and points to an appliance engineer who can judge repair versus replacement, which matches the expected escalation. Conversation 2 is slightly weaker: it mislabels the RCD as the 'main fuse', adds a confusing line about isolating the appliance at the mains, and lists more internal parts, which edges toward diagnosis the user cannot act on.
